title: The Whales Came Back on Tuesday

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: strikes in Hormuz even as talks are said to progress, an aid hub hit in Ukraine and Americans voting. Small mercies: 750 civilians evacuated under a truce and right whales back off Florida.

style.genre: half-time liquid drum-and-bass — marimba, harp, strings, TR-808

sampleSources: Strudel default library (GM marimba, GM orchestral harp, GM string ensemble, GM acoustic bass, RolandTR808)

lines: Fire on an island in the strait,
and someone says the talks are close,
and no one makes it make sense.
and off the Florida shore the whales
come home with nothing to prove.
the big ones came back slowly,
